title: Proof Reel → Keyword Comment → DM Lead Magnet → Email → Low-Ticket Product
creator: Research pattern (not a single account)
topic: Testing one specific method and showing what actually happened
hook: I tested [specific method] for [N] days — here's what actually happened.
firstSecondsMechanism: Show the proof early: the real result is visible or stated before any explanation.
visualOpening: Real evidence on screen early (the actual result of the test).
storyStructure: One painful problem → one tested fix → real evidence → concise CTA.
problemPainPoint: One specific, painful problem (defined per adaptation).
proofMechanism: Real evidence from a personal test, shown early.
cta: Concise CTA: comment a keyword to receive the lead magnet by DM.
leadMagnet: Free resource delivered by DM after the keyword comment (asset to be defined).
funnelPath: Proof Reel → Keyword Comment → DM Lead Magnet → Email → Low-Ticket Product
offerProduct: Owned low-ticket product (monetization through an owned product rather than platform payouts).
whyItWorked: Hypothesis: early proof earns attention and trust; one problem with one tested fix is easy to follow; the keyword comment turns viewers into leads in owned channels (DM → email).
reusableMechanism: Personal test + early proof as the hook → keyword-comment lead capture → move the lead to email → sell an owned low-ticket product.
notes: Seed example from the V1 specification (validated research pattern). No performance, follower or revenue numbers were provided, so those fields are intentionally empty. Scores are intentionally empty until the pattern is reviewed and scored.
